summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Alpha Compute Corp disclosing a restatement of audited financial statements for fiscal year ended March 31, 2026, due to administrative errors deemed material under IAS 8 and SAB 99/108. The restatement does not affect revenue, expenses, loss, balance sheet, cash flows, or equity; it only corrects certain amounts and disclosures. The company filed Amendment No. 2 to its Form 20-F concurrently. The audit committee discussed matters with CBIZ CPAs P.C. This is a routine accounting correction, not a special situation, with no transaction, strategic action, or abrupt management change.
